dataset: 20 Newsgroups via sklearn.datasets.fetch_20newsgroups(subset='all', remove=('headers', 'footers', 'quotes')) with its default shuffle (random_state=42); indices refer to that list
procedure: documents with more than 50 non-blank characters; ID = comp.* documents permuted with numpy RandomState(seed); first 90% = train, rest = eval (cap 800); each OOD category = 800 documents drawn without replacement with RandomState(seed).choice
